notes.title: Oops! Time for a patch.
notes.content:
[h2]Just like the ISS, MoonShot needed a patch![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45616674/675cef32877b15d33419ec8ba605dbf8787fecd5.png[/img]

Thanks for your patience with launch-day issues.  Here are the things we fixed in the this latest build (v9.4.3):

[list]
[*]  Fix achievement popups for repeated achievements
[*]  Fix several issues with autosave/autorestore
[*]  Fix bad state after autorestore, which triggered the game to reboot
[*]  Fix cloud sync backups getting out of sync
[*]  Fix saved game being inappropriately loaded in some cases (e.g. after game over)
[*]  Fix saved game being inappropriately deleted in some cases
[/list]

The fixes for the autosave/autorestore system necessitated a breaking change, so your game will start over when you load it again.  Apologies for that, and hopefully you didn't lose too much in just one day.

notes.title: Ready for launch!
notes.content:
It's official!  We have approval for launch on Monday, June 2nd!

After many rounds of feedback with Valve, everything is set, with builds ready for Windows, Mac, and Linux!

[i]A quick note for Linux users: if you have any issues, under Compatibility settings for the game, please choose "Legacy Runtime 1.0".[/i]

As a special deal, MoonShot is available for only [b]$1[/b].  Later, we plan to add new stories and convert this title into an anthology, so early players of MoonShot will get later titles [b]at no additional cost[/b].

And as always, we would love it if you would be so kind as to leave us a review.  Thanks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45616674/bdd65b8fe5b82c32ee7f9b1e007b0b24a095bd97.jpg[/img]

notes.title: MoonShot launching June 2nd!
notes.content:
Our first title is coming June 2nd, 2025!  MoonShot is a comedy text adventure game about NASA's Apollo 11 mission to land astronauts on the moon.  No prior experience with the genre is required.  If you can read, you can play.  The full game is somewhere between a short story and a novella in length, depending on how you choose to play it.  Explore all [b]9 endings and 24 achievements![/b]

As a special introductory price, we're only asking [b]$1![/b]  It's cheaper than therapy, and also [b]MUCH[/b] less effective.

And just to sweeten the deal... here's an exclusive photo of The Rock riding a unicorn.  It has nothing to do with the game, and it's our gift to you [u][b]at no charge.[/b][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45616674/74da7927834e83ba47df2558e45f756e58d7c965.png[/img]

So... would you gamble $1 on this game?  The Rock would.  (I hope.  If I can ever get in touch with his assistant...)

Check out our first trailer below, buy a copy on June 2nd, and if you would be so kind, please leave us a review once you've played it.  Thanks!
